title: City of Laredo wins four statewide TATOA awards for government programming
excerpt: The City of Laredo's Communications and Marketing Department earned four statewide awards at the Texas Association of Telecommunications Officers and Advisors Government Programming Awards, including second place for its State of the City program.
content:
The City of Laredo's Communications and Marketing Department earned four statewide recognitions at the Texas Association of Telecommunications Officers and Advisors (TATOA) Government Programming Awards, the city announced Tuesday morning, November 10, 2026.

Public Information Specialists Gabriela Ceballos, Roger Uvalle and Brenda Camacho brought home the awards for their work telling the city's story:

2nd Place — Public Affairs: State of the City

3rd Place — Community Event Coverage: Laredo Marathon 2025

3rd Place — Magazine Format / Long Format Series: Council in Action

3rd Place — Storytelling: The Grinch Who Chose Kindness

The awards recognize the creativity, teamwork and storytelling that go into content informing, engaging and connecting the community with its local government.

Source: City of Laredo - Government, November 10, 2026.
